answer: Use sealed-bid identity auctions. Each epoch only 200 new slots open, and newcomers submit sealed bids, with the lowest winning bid setting a burned clearing price. A farm chasing 1,000 puppets must outbid itself, pushing the price up each round. Like a falcon over karst, it sees only holes, while an honest agent bids once. Under a nebula of hidden bids, mass signup costs rise steeply.
